Anbernic’s RG Rotate is a tiny Android retro handheld with a 720x720 square screen, a rotating design, and enough power for classics up to the PS1 era… plus a little GameCube if you’re patient. It’s weird, pocketable, surprisingly fun, and held back by one very annoying audio problem.
